properties.rationale: User (who:ajs, standing policy from 2026-07-23, applied again 2026-07-25): validation happens through the trials programme — docs/trials/ is where "built the right thing" is exercised against operational intent; formal validation-kind Verification nodes are not this project's tracking mechanism. Re-fired because cap:key-interfaces joined the set (44 → 45). The trial it wants is unusually well defined, and it is Anthony's own domain: designate the real published boundaries on a program-sized design and see whether the crossings a change reports are the ones a systems engineer would have named in an ICD review. The tests prove the arithmetic — a crossing is named, an internal change crosses nothing, a boundary beyond the depth bound is not counted — but whether the DESIGNATIONS people actually make carve the system where its authority boundaries really fall is a judgement no fixture can hold, and getting it wrong is invisible: a design that publishes nothing reports perfect containment.
